newsitem.title: USA: Kmart names Flick president of U.S. stores.
newsitem.headline: Kmart names Flick president of U.S. stores.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Wednesday it promoted Warren Flick to the new post of president and chief operating officer of U.S. Kmart Stores, and named him to the board of directors.

Flick joined the company in December 1995 as president and general merchandise manager of U.S. Kmart Stores. In his new job Flick will be responsible for operation of Kmart's 2,020 traditional Kmart stores, and continue to oversee all aspects of merchandising, presentation, promotion and advertising.
Donald Keeble, executive vice president of store operations, will report to Flick under the new structure.
Flick's new job is effective November 1. His board appointment will take effect November 19.
